title: A Crown of Swords
author: Robert Jordan
summary: The seventh Wheel of Time book. The central characters are scattered, each chasing a goal of their own, while the larger struggle against the Dark One keeps gaining ground and alliances grow more uncertain.
readIf: you are already deep in the Wheel of Time and want its sprawling politics and many plot threads.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier books, or you want a fast, tidy story.

pairings.reason: Another huge, multi-viewpoint epic fantasy where politics matter as much as swords.
Equally long, richly built fantasy with many characters and a huge world.
A classic, leisurely epic fantasy in the same slow-building tradition.
